note: Isolated fixtures on the existing four-node mixed cluster and existing Argo CD. Native GHCR pulls, no component uploads through the API. CLI/Helm use verified published 0.5.0 assets. Argo changes the actual chart and provisioner version to a separate future conformance fixture and back; that fixture is not a Cargo or GitHub release. Shared assertions verify native component image identities and complete retained OCI graphs. No shared Node deletion/cordon, registry storage move, shared Argo restart or retained data deletion. Build receipt copies omit consumer node names; original receipt hashes are retained. Public Helm repository smoke acceptance is recorded separately after publication.
